name: nzt
description: NZT's optional mods for Claude Code (see specs/nzt-mods.md)

plugins.name: nzt-state
plugins.description: Live pane with the NZT plan and state from Plan/state.json

plugins.name: nzt-context
plugins.description: Context-used bar above the prompt with the NZT kernel's 20/30/40 marks

plugins.name: nzt-changes
plugins.description: Step through the last turn's edits or the project's changes against HEAD, one diff at a time

plugins.name: nzt-files
plugins.description: Browse the project like an editor's explorer: folders that open and close, git marks, and the chosen file beneath

plugins.name: nzt-hub
plugins.description: One pane with every NZT mod: what each is for, its version, a button that opens it, and the install command for the missing ones
